coverage_notes: Each rank passes homogeneousGPU and mixedGPU/Dense/HODLR local subtrees, then reuses the tested factors after Dense-parent Schur release for independent three-RHS solves.

MPIHODLRparentlegacy/compact and sparse-included/skipped checks are unconditional in the frozen fixture; finalPASS requires all four combinations before/after parent factorization. Parent-procsGPUconstruction lines corroborate both iterations.
The forced-memory case tests pre-handle admissionCPUfallback, not a cudaMalloc failure after successful admission. Its zero backenddevice bytes exclude fixtureballast and nativeBPACKheap.
BLAS identity is directly checked by each rankprobe. Native identity uses captured hashes, frozenrankwrapperpreload, and matching SONAME/NEEDED; there is no separate in-targetnative/proc-maps dump.
OMP1 and16physicalcores are recorded by the rankprobe; the logical affinity mask contains32SMT siblings, with no physicalcore overlap across ranks.
No zero-pivot/kernel-execution-error or failed-allocation exception-recovery path was exercised. No Poisson performance claim follows from this fixture.

confirmations.confirmed_sample_policy: Three PASS per tolerance/layout in one allocation; no pooling with initial/followup pilots or other nodes.

screenshot_reference.limits: GPU model, exact commands, compression tolerance and phase boundaries unavailable; compare reported factors only on count-matched layouts; not a controlled hardware reproduction.

limitations: Best tested Poisson/layout settings; no global-optimum claim.
Exact distributed fronts and exact solves remain CPU.
No complex runtime, multiple ranks/GPU, OpenMP>1 or other GPU-backend runtime claim for the new route.
Explicit memory/transfer counters exclude CUDA contexts, native pools and library-internal workspace.
Local API times are not pure kernel timings; bounded-helper subcounters overlap totals.
The ButterflyPACK main heap is lazy; fraction0.35 is tested, not proved necessary. Prior native work/repeated factorization may retain a competing pool.
Legacy GPU whole-batch size limits remain; the tested dimensions are within LP64 bounds.

selected_configuration.reason: Streams4 pilots showed no material benefit; streams1 needs less workspace. Larger local exact subtrees were admitted in whole GPU batches.

allocation_attempts_without_cases.reason: Immediate60 requests expired before any allocation or solver case; excluded from numerical counts.

notes: Factor and solve medians/ranges are independent summaries; paired-total median uses trial-wise sums.
Different compression thresholds change the preconditioner and iteration count; report both factor and paired factor+solve.
Exact-front GPU storage/factorization retain host factors and root Schur data; solve remains on the existing host path.
Exact-front transfer totals sum bytes across ranks/subtrees. Wall-time sums are rank-seconds, not critical-path time.
Explicit device peaks cover exact-front tracked allocations, not ButterflyPACK pool and whole-process memory.
MPI exact fronts retain CPU ScaLAPACK; GPU exact routing is for local subtrees.
The existing no-SLATE full-GPU-support warning is expected in this configuration.

recommended_tolerance.scope: only the two measured tolerances, with the selected thresholds; no global-optimum claim
